text:
Zoe: Two tiny polls in one thread because I'm indecisive today: 1) Best editor for fast hacking? VSCode, Neovim, IntelliJ. 2) Favorite model codename for our demo: Redwood, Atlas, Halcyon. Drop emoji votes or toss new names.
Marco: Love multitasking polls. Vote with numbers: :one: VSCode/:one: Redwood, :two: Neovim/:two: Atlas, :three: IntelliJ/:three: Halcyon.
build-bot: Polls created: 1) VSCode 2) Neovim 3) IntelliJ. And model codenames: 1) Redwood 2) Atlas 3) Halcyon. React to cast vote. Closing in 30m.
Theo: :two::two: Neovim + Atlas from me. Minimal and mysterious.
Ria: :one::one: VSCode + Redwood. Full disclosure: I'm biased.
Nina: :one::three: VSCode + Halcyon. Trying the contrarian combo.
Marco: :two::one: Neovim + Redwood 1 (wildcard for crossing categories).
Zoe: Also open to other model names: "Compass" or "Lighthouse"?
Theo: Compass is solid. Lighthouse is a bit on-the-nose.
Ria: Compass > Lighthouse. Also whoever loses owes donuts.
Nina: Stakes! Donuts motivate good voting hygiene.
build-bot: Interim tallies: Editors 1 VSCode: 2, Neovim: 2, IntelliJ: 0. Models 1 Redwood: 3, Atlas: 2, Halcyon: 1. Still open.
Zoe: OK closing in 5. Thanks for humoring my over-structured brain.
build-bot: Polls closed. Final results: Editors 1 VSCode 3, Neovim 2, IntelliJ 0. Models 1 Redwood 3, Atlas 2, Halcyon 1. Winners: VSCode & Redwood.
Marco: VSCode & Redwood it is. Donuts on Theo?
Theo: Sigh. Fine. Donuts tomorrow. But I'm secretly pleased with Atlas showing up.
Ria: New demo name idea: "Redwood/VSCode jam". Catchy?
Zoe: Love it. We'll use Redwood for the codename and call the live sesh "VSCode jam". Thanks all! :tada:
